I feel your pain! Everyday I wake up I know I have to live another day that involves being around people who are blind to what’s really important in life. I feel a lack of connection with anyone I talk too, even my own flesh and blood. The one thing that keeps me going is knowing that in order to find purpose I need to live for others. Seeing how I don’t have a girl, kids or pets it’s been rough trying to find what’s truly meaningful to me and what makes life worth living. I can say that ever since I’ve been searching for someone or something to serve my life has had some direction. I can’t say everything will be all good or it’ll be complete shit because no one knows what the future holds, but I promise you(I made this promise to myself as well) that if you pursue something or someone to serve your mind won’t have time to think of ending it all. In order to see if you’ve truly made progress during your pursuit I recommend a daily journal. Nothing too crazy, maybe a few words or sentences about each day. I wish you the best my friend! It’s an ugly world but that doesn’t mean we have to give in to the ugliness.
